name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a handyman?
description: A general contractor manages complex projects; a handyman handles smaller repairs and tasks.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor manages larger, more complex construction or renovation projects that often require multiple specialized trades and permits. They oversee the entire project from start to finish. A handyman typically handles smaller, isolated tasks or repairs that don't require extensive planning, permits, or coordination of multiple trades, such as minor fixes, installations, or upkeep around the house.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages complex projects; a handyman handles smaller repairs and tasks.
